scene: The glowing radio crackles with chatter, unlocking the busy treetop transit hub.
picture: Side view of a wide wooden transit deck among leafy branches. On the far left, a yellow rail-glider skate shuttle waits with open doors. Left of centre, the boy with dark hair and blue eyes stands holding his skateboard. In the centre, a red double-decker bus idles. On the far right, a paddle steamer docks beside a wooden ramp.
shown: a yellow rail-glider shuttle waiting on tracks on the far left
a red double-decker bus idling by a platform in the centre
a docked wooden paddle steamer floating by a ramp on far right
